description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate game UI icons arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, each centered in its own cell: metal gear cog (settings), golden trophy cup, rolled parchment quest scroll with a red wax seal, sealed envelope letter, folded treasure world map, golden royal crown, old iron padlock, red heart, small brass bell, chunky pixel art icons in the same style as the reference, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every icon fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with wide empty space around it, no text, no letters, no numbers

style_image.usage_description: Copy the art style of these icons exactly: chunky pixel art, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, warm palette. Draw NEW icons, not these ones.
